title: Checkpoint: Billing-Report Tool Standard Library ADR
summary: Close the standard-library module with an ADR and a plan for a billing-report tool: compute what float surcharges cost per month, how many UTC offsets the sources use and how many bytes one export line takes, then choose money, time, serialization, file, logging and CLI mechanisms that survive those numbers.
